summary: First test iteration for Cocoa Ledger app. Backend: 21/21 pytest tests passed covering auth, dashboard stats, customers CRUD + search + debt/repayment balance math, cocoa records (scaled/unscaled/enter-weight/summary/filter), cocoa rate (get/set/live graceful), staff management, and role enforcement (admin vs staff 403 on delete customer, delete confirmed cocoa record, set rate, list staff). Frontend: E2E playwright verified login (admin & staff), dashboard shows correct seeded stats (3 customers, N180,000 owed, 4,250 kg, 1 unscaled), Cocoa Rate tile shows 'Confidential' with lock icon (no numeric leak) and clicking navigates to /cocoa-rate, payout calculator works (10kg -> N85,000 at rate 8500), live rate shows graceful 'unavailable' message (ALPHA_VANTAGE_KEY empty), customer search by ID '001' filters correctly, edit-lock switch and calculator keys present on profile, cocoa records filter tabs (all/unscaled/scaled) all clickable, staff creation via UI works, and staff role enforcement is correct (staff user sees NO nav-staff link and /staff route redirects to home with no admin controls rendered).
critical_code_review_comments: CORS misconfiguration risk: backend/server.py sets allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' (from CORS_ORIGINS='*' in .env). Per CORS spec, browsers reject credentialed requests when origin is wildcard. Currently works because frontend calls same-origin '/api', but if a different origin ever calls the API, authenticated requests will fail silently. Recommend setting CORS_ORIGINS to the explicit REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL origin.

server.py is a single ~650-line file mixing auth, staff, customers, cocoa records, cocoa rate and dashboard concerns. It stays under the 700-line threshold but is close; splitting by router module would improve maintainability.
Startup uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'). FastAPI recommends the lifespan context manager. Not blocking, but will trigger deprecation warnings on newer FastAPI versions.
Password validation is not enforced server-side on staff creation (any short password accepted). Consider a minimum length / complexity check.
Live cocoa rate cache is stored in db.settings with hardcoded 6h TTL; if Alpha Vantage returns transient success once, unavailable is masked for 6h. Acceptable for now.

Dashboard is served at '/' (not '/dashboard') so use content selectors rather than URL patterns for post-login waits.
